name: email-service
description: Submit the two notifications the Centre Agent owns — prereview_completed and agent_unavailable — and read their delivery status.
notes: notification_kind must be one of the service's configured kinds. The two that belong to this actor are prereview_completed and agent_unavailable; the rest of CONFIGURED_NOTIFICATION_KINDS are other actors' business and sending them from here would make one mailbox speak for two workflows.
recipients are resolved by principal_id through the registry; an unbound recipient comes back as recipient_resolver_unavailable and the service writes nothing.

notification_id and dedupe_key are separate. dedupe_key is the business identity (one prereview of one candidate head), notification_id is the transport identity; reusing one with the other's content returns idempotency_conflict.

tools.name: send_notification
tools.description: Accept one human_notification_intent for later delivery.
allowed: telling the Project Owner a prereview round finished
telling the Project Owner an agent the mapping needs is offline

tools.name: get_notification_status
tools.description: Read delivery status. Ordinary callers only see their own notifications.
allowed: checking whether the owner was actually told

tools.name: health
tools.description: Return authenticated component status for delivery, audit, and mailbox.
allowed: separating a dead mailbox from a rejected notification
